import re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
repo = "/Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/monorepo/monorepo/amberjack"
cur_p = Path("/Users/yasyf/.claude/scratch/durable-agents-rebuild/drive-watchdog/headlabel.cursor")
since = int(cur_p.read_text().strip()) if cur_p.exists() else 147940
out = subprocess.run(["cci", "tail", "--drive", "durable-agents-rebuild", "--since", str(since), "--kind", "head", "--width", "400", "--budget", "40000"],
                     capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="/tmp").stdout
top = since
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
for line in out.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r"#(\d+) .* HEAD #(\d+) ([0-9a-f]{40}) \(was ([0-9a-f]{40})\): .*patch-identical \((\d+) commits?\)", line)
    s = re.match(r"#(\d+) ", line)
    if s:
        top = max(top, int(s.group(1)))
    if not m:
        continue
    seq, pr, new, old, n = m.groups()
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "fetch", "-q", "origin", new, old], capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        continue
    rd = git("range-diff", f"{old}~{n}..{old}", f"{new}~{n}..{new}")
    bad = [l for l in rd.splitlines() if re.match(r"\s*(\d+|-):\s+([0-9a-f]+|-+)\s+[<>!]", l)]
    if bad:
        print(f"HEAD-MISLABEL #{pr} {new[:7]} (record #{seq}) says patch-identical; range-diff: " + " | ".join(b.strip()[:140] for b in bad[:4]))
cur_p.write_text(str(top + 1))
